resources.string: Shows an ✨ button on dating profiles and in chats.

Lets RizzCoach recognise when you are on a profile or an open chat in Instagram, Tinder, Bumble, Hinge or Facebook, or an open chat in WhatsApp, Snapchat or Telegram, so it can offer an ✨ button.

On a profile, tapping ✨ captures that one screen for a report. In a chat, tapping ✨ reads the visible conversation so it can suggest a reply and copy it to your clipboard. In WhatsApp, Snapchat and Telegram only the chat reply is offered — no profile is captured there.

RizzCoach only reads the screen of those apps, and only when you tap ✨. Nothing is read or sent in the background, and screenshots are never saved to your device.
